name: Defender 03-Z
description: The Defender 03-Z was a model of battle droid that saw use during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. Similar to the Defender 01-X but with the addition of a personal shield, the Defender 03-Z carried a blaster rifle, and a number of them were deployed to protect the satellite control tower on the Markaran Plains of the planet Balmorra.
